tickets.title: Agents read policy vehicles only for policies they produce (S5 gate medium)
tickets.story: As a carrier I want an agent to see policy vehicles only for policies that agent produces so that staff accounts cannot enumerate policy numbers

sprints.name: Sprint 0: setup
sprints.goal: Coordination fabric, repo scaffold, CI, contracts, value-proposition ranking, dashboard skeleton

went_well: Contract-first: all 5 tickets ran fully parallel with zero serial dependencies
went_badly: Module service hook named init() in core but service() in contracts; caught only at orchestrator review
Agent labels lacked ticket IDs so spend needed manual mapping
Workflow concurrency cap (2) left 3rd council agent queued ~5 min
manager_retros: product: ranking needed a fictional model carrier; reuse MC-1 everywhere
platform: tests from other teams ran in our suite; keep tests path-scoped

shipped: Coordination fabric, CLI, spend accounting
Core runtime (router, RBAC tokens, tenant-scoped store, PII crypto, hash-chained audit, outbox bus)
PM dashboard skeleton
Value-driver ranking and 25 requirements
Architecture overview, 20 domain + 12 event schemas, 48-operation OpenAPI

sprints.name: Sprint 1: backbone
sprints.goal: Every backend module working against contracts; claimant + CSR UI; threat model; synthetic data; e2e harness

went_well: Contract-first parallelism held: zero serial dependencies; 58 agents across 3 workflows in ~26 min wall-clock
Security IC found a real tenant-isolation defect (INC-1) before any demo
went_badly: INC-1 escaped Sprint 0 review: store tests covered only bare table names
Auth/roles drift between openapi and core produced 4 duplicate contract-change requests nobody answered within the sprint (synapse latency = whole sprint)
Unit tests green per module, but cross-module calibration (severity bands, STP thresholds) only surfaced in e2e after acceptance
manager_retros: workflow: rules precedence ambiguity in domain-model.md cost a clarification; contract wording needs examples
ai: AdjusterView schema too strict (additionalProperties:false) for derived flags
experience: UI not exercised in a real browser; Playwright is available and should gate UI tickets
security: threat model at strong tier was the most expensive ticket ($0.23/pt) and the most valuable

shipped: All 9 backend modules (config, intake, claims, rules, coverage+mock PAS, evidence, triage, adjuster, integrations)
AI layer: local provider + Claude/Gemini on Vertex adapters + confidence cascade
Claimant web app and CSR portal; shared UI kit (en/es)
Two demo tenants (Aurelia Mutual, Kestrel Point Insurance; fictional)
Threat model, data-protection design, security regression suite (142 tests)
Synthetic data + e2e harness; scorecards and sprint tooling
risks: E2E scenarios: severity bands and fast-track expectations disagree between triage/rules and QE scenarios (54 failing subtests)

sprints.name: Sprint 2: integrate and complete
sprints.goal: All e2e scenarios green for both tenants; adjuster + admin UIs; KPI instrumentation; contracts reconciled; Playwright UI smoke tests

went_well: Integration squad (single strong-tier owner) fixed 54 e2e failures in one ticket: one owner for cross-module behaviour works
Architecture triage cleared the hub backlog: synapse latency down from a full sprint to same-sprint
went_badly: 11 escaped defects from Sprint 1 found this sprint (7 security highs, 4 UI bugs): Sprint 1 reviewers checked unit tests only
Two test files (route snapshot, YAML parser) broke from a contract version bump; contract owner could not edit them (paths)
One reviewer did not record its verdict in the fabric
manager_retros: experience: Playwright found 4 real bugs in hours; should have existed in Sprint 1
security: review at mid tier found 7 highs; cost $0.4/pt and worth it
integration: pinning ctx.clock in e2e removed spurious late-report fraud flags

shipped: All e2e scenarios green for both tenants (149/149); root causes recorded as defects
Adjuster first view and carrier admin console; Playwright smoke tests for all four apps
KPI endpoint for VD-1..VD-7; policy search; commercial auto coverage and Kestrel question set
Contracts v1.2.0: 25 hub requests answered (IMP-5)
AI guardrails wired into the cascade + offline eval harness
Dockerfile, Cloud Run manifest, deployment guide; smoke script in CI
Security code review: 23 findings (0 critical, 7 high)
risks: 7 high security findings open (tracked as todo tests)
GCP deployment still blocked on credentials

sprints.name: Sprint 3: harden and document
sprints.goal: Close all 7 high security findings and 4 UI defects; prove the PoC definition of done per LOB; configuration guide, demo script, COTS readiness

went_well: Security gate found a high the acceptance reviewer missed, and the rework loop fixed it in-sprint
A docs agent that rehearsed the demo against the running system found real product gaps that unit and e2e tests did not
IC refused to weaken a security control to make tests pass and escalated instead (S3-INT-02)
went_badly: A correct fix (estimate totals) regressed severity calibration because AI tiers and triage tiers are duplicated across team boundaries
Gate findings JSON captured pre-rework state, so a fixed high was reported Open
Sprint 3 needed an orchestrator-dispatched follow-up wave
manager_retros: product: rehearsing the demo should happen in Sprint 2, not Sprint 3
quality: DoD test needed GET /claims after submit because submit returns a summary; contract says full Claim
integration: duplicated tier constants need one owner (move to src/ai schemas)

shipped: All 7 Sprint 2 high security findings fixed with real regression tests (security suite 175 pass / 0 fail)
Security gate (IMP-9) caught and fixed a new high (SEC3-001) within the sprint
4 UI defects fixed and verified in Chromium
Definition-of-done test per LOB incl. signed webhook + core adapter; tenant-differences test
Demo data on first start; configuration guide, 10-minute demo script, COTS readiness assessment, docs index
risks: Demo rehearsal found 4 product gaps + 2 bugs (UI claims cannot reach coverage/fast-track; adapter profile key; config overwritten at boot): Sprint 4
GCP deployment still blocked on credentials

sprints.name: Sprint 4: close the demo gaps
sprints.goal: Fix the product gaps found while rehearsing the demo and assessing COTS readiness; close Sprint 3 security-gate mediums; automate the demo as a test

went_well: Every demo gap found in Sprint 3 is closed and proved by an automated demo test

went_badly: 5 more Sprint 0-1 escapes surfaced (product gaps found only by rehearsal); IMP-11 is the fix

ai: duplicated tier constants with triage remain a fragility

ReDoS and DoS fixes in guardrails, local extractor, evidence parser; intake idempotency namespacing and encrypted suggestions
